title: Market-closed wording: the study has no closed-market screen (G-11-3, capture part)
reference_behaviour: The study shows only a clock line for prices and one help line saying values are calculated as of the last market close when the market is not open on the target time; no screen for a closed market was captured.
ours: ADR-177 fixed one wording everywhere: Market closed. Prices are from <time>. Owner to capture the reference product's screen on a closed day.
